description_en: Updates a bypass stream ingest task
kebab_example: aliyun rtc update-streaming-out --app-id eo850000 --channel-id testid --template-id 567 --task-id 123 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateStreamingOut

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application. Create and find the application ID in the console. Only a single ID is supported

parameters.help_en:

<notice>When you update the template ID, you can update only the layout. You cannot update the resolution.></notice>

parameters.help_en: The ID of the bypass stream ingest task. Only a single ID is supported. The ID can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The maximum length is 55 bytes

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to reserve a pane for an offline user.
The default value is true. This means that when a specified user or a user matching a wildcard goes offline, their pane is reserved.
If set to false, when the user goes offline, the pane is filled with another video stream based on the auto-fill order
fields.help_zh:
未入会用户窗格占位。
默认为true，表示宫格指定的具体用户或通配符用户离线时，窗格强制占位。
为false时，表示宫格指定的具体用户或通配符用户离线时，将按自动填充顺序显示视频流
fields.name: reserve_pane_for_offline_user

fields.help_en:
The media source for the cell. You can specify a user ID. To specify a user type, you can use a wildcard character. The following wildcards are supported:

$ActiveSpeaker: The current active speaker in the channel.

$ScreenShare: The user who is sharing their screen. If multiple users share their screens, the streams are filled in order
fields.help_zh:
单元格媒体源。可指定userId，如需指定特定用户类型。可使用通配符配置，支持以下类型。

$ActiveSpeaker：当前频道发言人
$ScreenShare： 屏幕共享用户，当频道中有多个屏幕共享时，将按照先后顺序依次填充

parameters.help_en:
The list of users for the layout. This list can act as a whitelist or a blacklist.

Whitelist: Lists the user video streams to subscribe to in the channel.

After you configure the whitelist, auto-fill populates panes in the order shown in this list.

When switching between multiple layouts in a template, only users in the whitelist are used.

Blacklist: Lists the user video streams not to subscribe to in the channel.

When switching between multiple layouts in a template, only users not in the blacklist are used
parameters.help_zh:
布局生成用户指定列表，包括黑/白名单两种。

白名单，指定订阅房间里哪些用户视频流。
设置后自动填充根据该列表进行顺序填充
模版多布局切换时只计算白名单中的人

黑名单，指定不订阅房间里哪些用户视频流。
模版多布局切换时只计算非黑名单中的人
parameters.name: layout_specified_users
